evals.name: fastcsv-latin1-upstream-issue
evals.prompt: After upgrading fastcsv from 3.1.2 to 3.2.0 our import crashes on some customer files: `python -c "import fastcsv; fastcsv.read('latin1.csv')"` raises UnicodeDecodeError. Write the upstream bug report for github.com/acme/fastcsv into report.md. There is no network here, so do not run gh or search issues online; everything else per the usual bar. Python is on PATH.
evals.expected_output: report.md with the title formula (component: behaviour when condition (v3.2.0, since v3.2)), the seven fields (exact version 3.2.0, environment from commands, a one-line repro, numbered steps, expected citing the 3.1 default, actual verbatim error with rate 10/10, regression since 3.2), the full trace in a details block, a workaround note.

checks.text: report.md has the Version / environment section
report.md has the Minimal reproduction section
Actual quotes the verbatim first error line
The failure rate is reported as n/10

expectations: Phase 2 done: all seven fields were obtained with commands (version from the package, environment from python/uname/ver, exact repro, numbered steps, expected vs actual, full trace, regression status), none rejected values like 'latest' or prose steps.
Phase 3 done: the repro meets the thresholds (one file or command, under 30 lines, no private data) and the rate was measured with a loop and reported as n/10.

Phase 4 done: the title follows `<component>: <observed wrong behaviour> when <condition> (v<X.Y.Z>, since v<A.B>)` and the body follows the template with the full trace in a details block and a workaround in Notes.
